purpose: Preserve the already pushed R1 carrier byte-for-byte while adding a post-commit validator lifecycle that proves synchronized branch blobs, closed changed paths and a complete review authority boundary.

resolvedFindings.finding: The R1 validator interpreted its sealed Frontend semantic predecessor as the current branch head and therefore could not pass after the carrier commit containing the validator itself.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Retain the semantic predecessor as immutable evidence, pin the pushed R1 commit as the validation-lifecycle predecessor, and require it to be an ancestor of synchronized local and origin dwp-dev.

resolvedFindings.finding: The R1 review validation required artifact pins and zero severity but did not compare every review identity, authority and completion-credit field as a closed set.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The R2 validator compares review identity, exact two-artifact pins, reviewer dispositions, complete authority object, zero completion credit and next action by exact equality.

resolvedFindings.finding: An ancestry-only post-commit check could accept unrelated descendant paths or worktree bytes that differed from synchronized local and origin branch blobs.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require exact R1-to-current and semantic-predecessor-to-current changed-path sets, compare all six carrier files with local and origin blobs, reject staged or unstaged carrier differences, and require a clean Frontend worktree.

resolvedFindings.finding: An in-place correction of the already sealed and pushed R1 review and validator would violate their APPEND_ONLY_SUCCESSOR_WITH_NEW_ID_AND_SHA256 amendment policy.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Restore all R1 artifacts exactly and place every lifecycle correction in this separately identified, separately reviewed R2 directory.

resolvedFindings.finding: Unrelated Calendar quality changes in the shared Frontend checkout prevent that checkout from satisfying the required clean-worktree post-push admission without risking another owner's work.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Stage and commit only the three R2 paths, then execute post-push admission from a clean isolated verification worktree whose HEAD equals synchronized local and origin dwp-dev; a named branch checkout is not required.

semanticPreservation.adapterScope: Replace only the obsolete exact-current-Frontend-head assertion with immutable semantic-predecessor ancestry while retaining exact Backend and Agent heads; all R1 transport, authorization, migration, allowlist, lineage, ownership, review-pin and source-withheld checks still execute.

validationAdmission.reason: This append-only correction changes documentation and admission validation only; product authorization v63, Auth V273 and all runtime source remain unauthorized and absent.

nextAction: Independently review this exact R2 correction, commit and push only its three files on Frontend dwp-dev, require a post-push PASS, then prepare a separate clean Backend and Frontend central execution authority and one-shot tokens for the allowlisted v63, V273 and unmounted mirror implementation.
nonClaims: This correction does not replace, amend or re-seal any R1 artifact.
